ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda safe-mode reboot prep via bcdedit (pre-encryption EDR evasion)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Qilin/Agenda tradecraft of arming `bcdedit /set {default} safeboot ...` so that a forced reboot drops the host into Safe Mode (where most EDR drivers do not load) before the Rust/Go encryptor executes. Documented across Qilin/Agenda affiliate intrusions by Trend Micro, Group-IB and Sophos X-Ops, and re-used in the 2024 Synnovis (UK NHS) incident.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*/set {default} safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*minimal*" OR Processes.process="*network*") by Processes.dest Processes.process_id _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "\$$") | join type=left dest [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as reboot_time values(Processes.process) as reboot_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="shutdown.exe" OR Processes.process="*Restart-Computer*" OR Processes.process="*shutdown /r*" OR Processes.process="*shutdown -r*") by Processes.dest] | where isnull(reboot_time) OR (reboot_time >= firstTime AND reboot_time <= firstTime+1800) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) ctime(reboot_time) | table firstTime dest user cmd parent reboot_time reboot_cmd
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let SafeBoot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SafeBootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SafeBootParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Reboots = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName in~ ("shutdown.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) and 
            (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("shutdown /r","shutdown -r","/r /f /t","Restart-Computer"))
    | project RebootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RebootCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
SafeBoot
| join kind=leftouter Reboots on DeviceId
| where isnull(RebootTime) or RebootTime between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| project SafeBootTime, DeviceName, AccountName, SafeBootCmd, SafeBootParent, SafeBootParentCmd, RebootTime, RebootCmd
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let SafeBoot = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetProcessName endswith "bcdedit.exe"
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              SafeBootCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
              SafeBootParent = ActingProcessName,
              SafeBootParentCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine;
let Reboots = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (TargetProcessName endswith "shutdown.exe")
         or (TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("shutdown /r","shutdown -r","Restart-Computer"))
    | project RebootTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, RebootCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;
SafeBoot
| join kind=leftouter Reboots on DvcHostname
| where isnull(RebootTime) or RebootTime between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| project SafeBootTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, SafeBootCmd, SafeBootParent, SafeBootParentCmd, RebootTime, RebootCmd
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Safe-Mode Boot Configuration via bcdedit
id: 8b2a4d1e-5c6f-4a7b-9d3e-2f1c8b6e9a4d
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit being used to configure Safe-Mode boot, a signature Qilin/Agenda ransomware pre-encryption technique used to evade EDR drivers that do not load in Safe Mode.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/h/new-golang-ransomware-agenda-customizes-attacks.html
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1529
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot minimal'
      - 'safeboot network'
      - '/set safeboot'
      - '/set {default} safeboot'
      - '/set {current} safeboot'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT troubleshooting (rare and typically scheduled)
  - Driver developers debugging boot drivers
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) OR @NewProcessName:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE)) (@CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT* OR *SafeBoot*) OR @process.command_line:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT*)) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i
| regex("safeboot", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| UserName!=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 | ImageFileName=/\\shutdown\.exe$/i OR regex("Restart-Computer", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR regex("shutdown\s+[/-]r", field=CommandLine, flags="i") | rename(field=CommandLine, as=RebootCommandLine) | rename(field=_time, as=RebootTime)}, field=aid, include=[RebootCommandLine, RebootTime], limit=200000)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine], function={min(_time, as=SafeBootTime) | min(RebootTime, as=RebootTime) | collect([RebootCommandLine])})
| eval DeltaSec := (RebootTime - SafeBootTime) / 1000
| (RebootTime = 0 OR DeltaSec < 1800)
ucs.rationale: Qilin/Agenda is one of the very few RaaS families that systematically uses Safe-Mode boot as a pre-encryption EDR-evasion step — observed across Trend Micro, Group-IB, Sophos, and Mandiant write-ups since the original Agenda Golang variant in 2022 and continuing into the Qilin Rust rebrand. ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin Chrome credential harvest via GPO-pushed PowerShell (Synnovis/Sophos 2024 tradecraft)
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin-specific affiliate tradecraft, first publicly documented by Sophos X-Ops in August 2024, in which after compromising a domain controller the operators distribute a logon-script GPO that runs PowerShell on every domain-joined endpoint to copy Chrome's `Login Data` SQLite database to a network share for offline DPAPI-cracking. Looks for PowerShell/script-host processes touching the Chrome `Login Data` file across an unusual number of hosts in a short window — the cross-host fan-out is what separates Qilin's mass-harvest from a single attacker laptop.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc values(Filesystem.process) as cmd values(Filesystem.user) as user min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime dc(Filesystem.dest) as host_count values(Filesystem.dest) as hosts from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="Login Data" Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*" (Filesystem.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="pwsh.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="cmd.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="wscript.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="cscript.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="robocopy.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="xcopy.exe") by Filesystem.user span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where host_count >= 3 AND NOT match(user, "\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - host_count
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let HostFanout = 3;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FolderPath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\"
| where FileName =~ "Login Data" or FileName =~ "Login Data-journal" or FileName startswith_cs "Login Data"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe","esentutl.exe","sqlite3.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| summarize HostCount = dcount(DeviceName),
            Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 50),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            SampleParent = any(InitiatingProcessParentFileName)
            by InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where HostCount >= HostFanout
| order by HostCount desc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let HostFanout = 3;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where TargetFilePath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\"
| where TargetFileName startswith "Login Data"
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe","esentutl.exe","sqlite3.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileCopied","FileRenamed")
| summarize HostCount = dcount(DvcHostname),
            Hosts = make_set(DvcHostname, 50),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
            by ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where HostCount >= HostFanout
| order by HostCount desc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:11 OR @EventID:4663) @TargetFilename:(*\Google\Chrome\User Data\*Login Data* OR *\google\chrome\user data\*login data*) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\robocopy.exe OR *\xcopy.exe OR *\esentutl.exe OR *\sqlite3.exe) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=FileWritten OR #event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo OR #event_simpleName=FileRenameInfo)
| regex("\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data\\\\", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| regex("Login Data", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|robocopy|xcopy|esentutl|sqlite3)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([UserName, ContextImageFileName], function={count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=HostCount) | collect([ComputerName], multival=true, limit=50) | min(_time, as=FirstSeen) | max(_time, as=LastSeen)})
| HostCount >= 3
| sort(HostCount, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: This is THE distinguishing Qilin behaviour from the Sophos X-Ops August-2024 publication 'Qilin ransomware caught stealing credentials stored in Google Chrome': after DC compromise, the affiliate pushes a domain-wide logon-script GPO that runs PowerShell on every endpoint to grab `Login Data` and stage it on a share.
